ابتذلت (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْتُ (ibtaḏaltu) /ib.ta.ðal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذَلْتَ (ibtaḏalta) /ib.ta.ðal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذَلْتِ (ibtaḏalti) /ib.ta.ðal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذَلَتْ (ibtaḏalat) /ib.ta.ða.lat/: third-perso
